headline: Expanse Seesaw Grinds On; Wardens Rebuild, Fisherman's Row Flares
war_summary: The Weathered Expanse keeps its violent see-saw: the Wardens now hold four of nine bases there against five, both posts formerly in ruin no longer so, while Crow's Nest and Frostmarch between them account for thirty-five of the front's forty-two daily base actions and the twenty-four-hour ledger runs near 7,000 Colonial against 10,000 Warden. Stlican Shelf tells a like tale of recovery, the Warden count back to four against five, Fort Hoarfrost the busiest post in the region at ten recorded changes. Mooring County's map stirred again — the Wardens now ten of twelve after a Colonial gain — with returns filed at the press moment. Palantine Berm stands seven-nil on paper, yet thirteen flip-events, chiefly at Leiri Hermanni, deny any quiet. Callahan's Passage sees the Warden grip extended to nine of ten under a daily toll of 8,611 Colonial and 9,221 Warden. Fisherman's Row flared in the final two hours, five base actions with the Wardens twice taking ground, Oceanwatch busiest. The Nevish Line and Linn Mercy have been map-silent near a day. It is day 386; thirty-four victory towns decide the war, and no victor is named.
